summary: Iter 57 Launch Hardening — validated all three items: (1) DEMO role paper-setup pre-seeds ~21 closed trades + 2 open positions with non-zero realized_pnl and equity != starting_balance (backend); (2) OWNER role paper-setup yields a FRESH book with 0 trades and 0 realized_pnl — role-aware demo overlay works; (3) Resend transactional emails — owner-notification on /api/access/request delivered successfully (verified via backend log: 'Sent email to vamsimadhavyakasiri@gmail.com'), user-notification on approve/reject fails gracefully (Resend test-mode rejects non-owner recipients — logged but swallowed, endpoint returns 200 ok). Full web onboarding wizard end-to-end verified (welcome → research → capital(25000) → alloc(fixed 1000) → strategies(hunter) → summary → onboarding-finish → wizard dismissed → localStorage 'ananta_onboarded'='1' → Cockpit shows populated $25k account with toast 'Paper trading is live'). critical_code_review_comments: Cosmetic (from iter56 still open): server.py /api/auth/login response body hardcodes role='owner' and email=OWNER_EMAIL regardless of the authenticated identity. JWT payload is correct; /auth/me returns the right values; but the login response body is a footgun for any future client that trusts it directly. Not blocking this iteration.

email_service.py — resend errors are swallowed by design (fire-and-forget) and only logged. Good defensive pattern for MVP. In production, consider a dead-letter queue / retry so a genuine outage doesn't silently drop approval emails.
